name: khasky/khasky-awesome-agent-skills
description: A large audit and review skill collection (49 folders), drafted here cherry-pick only, led by a read-only security audit skill. The audit subset covers security, dependency, leak, privacy, and code review and quality audits, with explicit read-only behavior and no edits applied.
install: npx skills add khasky/awesome-agent-skills (single-skill variant with -s documented, with a README warning that single-skill installs can leave cross-skill reference links dangling) and plugin routes (Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Antigravity). Draft scope is cherry-pick (the security-audit sample and named audit skills), never the install-everything route.
